points: Your site answers shipping costs and 10 working day delivery, yet 0 of 30 ads mention either. New buyers cannot judge the cost before clicking, so they scroll past. Name shipping cost and delivery in line one of new buyer ads.

One exact copy runs in 5 of 15 ads, so the same message repeats. Keep the body, but rewrite the opening line and creative in each of the five, so each ad gives its own reason to buy the Advent calendar.
None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so new buyers get no reason to trust the brand at a glance. Collect one figure, like a review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.
The Advent calendar opener opens 5 of 15 copy ads, and the other copy ads each open on a single line. Test two new angles against it, the price of a mini pot and a kids gift, in three ads each.
